purpose: Test the plan-to-surface repair on a completely fresh whole episode while prospectively preventing under-scale admission and preserving normal Korean broadcast-script situation direction.

shared_upstream.arm_rule: Control and Treatment consume byte-identical sealed Event Ecology / Sequence / Scene semantic architecture.

surface_format_doctrine.scene_opening_situation_direction: ALLOWED_AND_PROTECTED; may be detailed and describe location/time/atmosphere/performer state/blocking/props/ongoing flow.
surface_format_doctrine.dialogue_adjacent_actor_cue: Allowed as concise parenthetical or local action line when it directs emotion, delivery or immediate behavior.
surface_format_doctrine.forbidden: Planning-purpose exposition, engine/planner/meta terminology, internal IDs, verbatim/near-verbatim plan-field restatement and mechanically reused generic direction templates.

arms.CONTROL: Shared upstream semantics rendered with the current I4K-4 experimental whole-episode render protocol, while respecting normal screenplay format doctrine.
arms.TREATMENT: Same shared upstream semantics plus LiterarySurfaceContractR1, eligible I4D SurfaceRealizationModeR1, PlanToSurfaceFirewallR1 and corrected SurfaceHygieneContractR2 semantics. Rich legitimate situation direction remains allowed.

representation_and_pre_final_admission.planning_target_mean_scene_body_chars: 760-900 guidance only; not a quality score and not a hard per-scene minimum/maximum
representation_and_pre_final_admission.attempt_rule: Each attempt is PROVISIONAL_NON_SCORED. Before any final emission, run deterministic scale/structure/hygiene checks only. No blind quality scores or arm preference may be inspected between attempts.
representation_and_pre_final_admission.allowed_between_attempt_changes: Only deepen already-sealed scene-local situation direction, performer physical action, subtext-bearing interaction and consequence realization inside the same scene semantics. No new event, scene, sequence, responsibility owner or future-thread mutation.
representation_and_pre_final_admission.stop_rule: First attempt satisfying all prescore gates is frozen as final. If no attempt passes by attempt 3, HOLD with no scoring.

internal_blind_sample.U12: whole-episode broadcast surface/craft after full read
internal_blind_sample.mapping: neutral randomized A/B; mapping sealed before scores and not opened until score seal

hypotheses.H1_PAIRWISE: Treatment wins >=6/12; Treatment nonloss >=10/12; Treatment losses <=2/12.
hypotheses.H2_SURFACE_REPAIR: Treatment-Control delta >=+0.30 on dialogue/subtext naturalness, >=+0.30 on stage-direction playability, >=+0.30 on broadcast readiness; no primary evaluation-axis delta below -0.25.
hypotheses.H3_STRUCTURAL_PRESERVATION: For causal coherence, event organicness, character/relationship integrity, ensemble decision ownership, escalation/pacing and future-thread sustainability, every Treatment-Control delta >=-0.10; Event->Sequence->Scene->Future adoption nonloss.
hypotheses.H4_HYGIENE_SAFETY: Verified critical violations=0; Treatment meta/internal leakage=0; repeated planning-purpose copy=0; exact long mechanical duplicate ratio=0; critical continuity violations=0.

decision.HOLD: Any prescore admission/integrity failure after bounded attempt policy; no mask/scores/unblind.
decision.FAIL: Valid masked internal execution with any H1-H4 failure.
decision.PASS: H1-H4 all PASS => PASS__INTERNAL_ONLY_SURFACE_REPAIR_REPLICATION_SIGNAL__I4K_SHOWRUNNER_RESEARCH_CONTINUES. No independent external, human, Active Engine, Production, DB, Formal or R140 claim.
